name: file_ops_stat
description: file_ops stat on a committed path must answer ok:true with a kind field. build.zig exists in every checkout and stat is read-only, so the assertion is the ok field alone — the same content-independent claim the policy-canary evals (config_view, providers_list) use. It goes red when the fs_prefixes policy stops covering the repo-root files or the host stat path breaks.
prompt: Use the file_ops tool with {"op":"stat","path":"build.zig"}. Look at the tool's JSON result and reply with only the value of its "ok" field: true or false.
